note: TinyMind v2 dataset manifest (brief section 13, revised for real pretraining data). Read by 'tinymind data prepare-external' (materialises every entry, e.g. as tokenizer-training input) and 'tinymind data prepare-corpus' (turns the 'local'/'url' entries into the deduplicated, split, decontaminated Stage-1 pretraining corpus with provenance), and by the train-50m workflow. This DEFAULT manifest is hermetic: it needs no network. Its only natural-text source is a small committed SAMPLE (datasets/v2/samples/, CC0) that lets the whole corpus pipeline run end to end offline; it is far too small to teach language, so the Stage-1 objective refuses to call language acquired from it (configs/stages_v2/stage1.objective.json requires data.natural_train_bytes >= 20 MB). For a real run, add 'url' or 'local' entries for a real corpus (see datasets/v2/corpus.manifest.example.json: sharded public URLs, per-shard sha256, auth_env for private data) and prepare with --allow-download. Prepared and downloaded corpora are never committed (see .gitignore). The synthetic entries are SUPPLEMENTAL, not the primary Stage-1 data.

datasets.description: Small committed natural-English sample (continuous prose) so the real-corpus pipeline runs offline; a real Stage-1 run adds a large corpus via 'url'/'local' entries.
Deterministic synthetic language examples; SUPPLEMENTAL to the natural-text corpus, not the primary Stage-1 data.
Deterministic synthetic knowledge/definition examples; SUPPLEMENTAL to a real Stage-3 knowledge corpus.
